findings.bilingualDescription: DE and EN claim the same integrated microscopy workflow: select a preparation, safely examine the specimen, identify characteristic observable features, draw and document it. The alternatives microorganisms/tissues/cells/substances/materials delimit specimen types rather than demand all of them in every performance.
findings.scopeAndAtomicity: One coherent practical preparation-and-evaluation process. This is explicitly the separate selected Bavarian biological-chemical practical course, not a newly established ordinary national chemistry GK/LK duty. Supplied provenance and page breadcrumb are not proof of complete external source/course mapping.
findings.pageImageActual: Viewed actual rendered PDF physical page3 / logical goal page1. Three stations show angled coverslip preparation, a goggled observer using the microscope and an illustrative labelled cell drawing. Zellkern pointer reaches the central purple nucleus and Zytoplasma points to the yellow cell interior. Drawing and schematic are teaching aids, not the specimen that a learner must reproduce or an actual optical observation. findings.performanceBoundary: Both full cases require actual own preparations and observed safe microscope operation, original drawings and documentation. Printed schematic, supplied external protocol and invented values cannot earn those practical observations. The source text and complete profiles explicitly keep this distinction.

wholeCaseChecks.reason: Supervised thin onion epidermis and an angled coverslip address layering/bubbles. Start40x total, then100x; 40x objective is used only with clearance and fine focusing. An unstained nucleus may be invisible, so the solution correctly forbids adding one from a familiar diagram. A moving round inclusion can be an artefact, not a certain nucleus. The changed folded specimen requires re-preparation reasoning, not a number swap.

Starch granules are material particles, not entire cells. Own nonselective sampling and calibration are separate from the constructed three-granule datasets. Switching100x to400x without calibration makes new micrometre estimates unsupported while some qualitative shape observations may remain; this is meaningful transfer.

findings.safety: Proportionate supervision, goggles, controlled glass handling and water mounts; food-grade starch avoids dust/inhalation/tasting. No demand for untrained handling of pathogens or stains.
